transcript: Northwind Labs leave policy, version 2. Effective 1 January 2026. Full-time staff get 18 days of paid leave per year. Unused days do not carry over.

decisions.statement: Northwind Labs grants full-time staff 18 days of paid leave per year.
quotes: Full-time staff get 18 days of paid leave per year.

decisions.statement: Northwind Labs does not allow unused leave days to carry over.
